blocks.text: Written by Koko Alviar The Jesus Is Lord Church Worldwide (JILCW) marked its 48th founding anniversary on October 10 with a grand celebration at the Quirino Grandstand in Rizal Park, Manila, drawing more than a million members, families, international delegations, and supporters from across the Philippines and around the world. Anchored on the theme “Abba Father,” the celebration highlighted God’s faithful fatherhood and boundless love. In her inspiring opening message, JILCW Executive Vice President Rev. Jovi Villanueva-Binalla, the youngest child of JILCW Founder and President Bishop Bro. Eddie Villanueva, described God as a personal Father whose love surpasses every human relationship. […]...
